title: IBO: INPAINTING-BASED OCCLUSION TO ENHANCE EXPLAINABLE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE EVALUATION IN HISTOPATHOLOGY
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of explainable AI (XAI) methods within the domain of histopathology. It utilizes inpainting techniques to improve the accuracy of XAI performance metrics and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
